security.scope: Targeted static review of published JavaScript/Python entries, local MCP transport, memory storage, hooks, subprocess and network sinks; no plugin activation or dependency installation

flymemory.result: No admission-blocking issue found in reviewed paths

controls.note: Loopback default; private plugin data directory; seeding another pickle library is explicit and off by default.
Native capture requires a typed user source with rpcId; credential-marker filters run before capture. Recalled text is identified as historical data.
Python child uses argument arrays with no shell; executable/script/model overrides are operator configuration.
FastMCP default loopback transport; README requires mcp >=1.30,<2. Upstream v1.30.0 enables Host/Origin DNS-rebinding protection for 127.0.0.1. No permissive CORS override is present.
Pickle database paths are configured locally, not MCP tool inputs; only self-generated or trusted libraries may be loaded. No untrusted pickle import endpoint is exposed.
Context and compaction checkpoint persistence are expected features; shared memory and automatic persistence are disclosed in catalog copy.

outbound: Hugging Face embedding model download on first use
npm registry only for the explicit CLI version check
limitations: Third-party Python dependencies and downloaded model binaries were not audited
Credential filters are heuristic; no claim that all secrets are detected
No package-declared DSH compatibility range; README test claims are not runtime verification

video.result: Existing backpressure defect remains in 0.1.2; do not migrate or grant a local reviewed badge
video.flow: An admitted stream request for a large workspace video enters ReadableStream.start(); its loop reads and enqueues the whole requested range without checking demand or implementing pull/cancel.
video.impact: A slow consuming client can cause buffering proportional to video size. This is a resource issue within the existing authenticated route, not an unauthenticated arbitrary-file claim.
video.counterEvidence: 4 MiB chunks bound individual reads; route uses the DSH connection API and fs sandbox. Neither bounds the accumulated stream queue.
video.currentConfig: Keep Git 0.1.0 unchanged; the old version shares this defect and is not described as a safe fallback.

mobile.result: No new admission-blocking issue found in the reviewed release diff

controls.note: Administrative CIDR access remains off by default; explicit lists are bounded, parsed and reject /0.
Direct socket peer, loopback Host, Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site and mutation-header controls remain; any non-loopback admin caller also requires DSH authentication.
Remote administration is admitted only when the local DSH login advertises a token; requestRejection must validate the request.

New directory creation is behind existing device authorization and CSRF checks; JSON is bounded, name must be one safe child segment, parent is explicit, mkdir is non-recursive and does not overwrite.
Picker create action is explicit; path/name are textContent/input values and JSON request data, not HTML or shell code. Cancellation/timeout cannot silently retry writes.

mobile.sourceMapping: Published bundles are generated from the public TypeScript tree at the recorded commit. Reviewed changed controls correspond to src/config.ts, src/http-security.ts, src/plugin.ts, src/computer-images.ts, src/gateway.ts and client picker sources; no local rebuild or byte-for-byte reproducible-build claim.
limitations: Inherits the previous partial static review of unchanged code

bug91.screenshot: The web boot waits for dsh-open-market: remote.pluginMarket
bug91.rootCause: The browser module declared an optional experimental service as a mandatory startup injection.
bug91.fix: Keep the base browser module and settings active without the service; scope the browsing tab to a dynamic remote.pluginMarket injection so it appears and disposes with that service.
bug91.release: Source fix only; the npm 0.2.4 artifact is unchanged. Keep #91 open while awaiting installed versions and a published fix.
bug91.workaround: Disable dsh-open-market in recovery plugin management to restart; enable Custom plugin markets before re-enabling the plugin.

ci.failure: Both post-publication jobs failed before checking the site: maintainer-reviews imported github.mjs, which eagerly imports the catalog SDK absent in deployment checkouts.
ci.fix: Move repository URL parsing into a dependency-free module and migrate callers; the publication checker can start without node_modules.
ci.reproduction: New isolated-checkout regression test failed with the same ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before the fix and passed after it.

replies.body:
感谢提交！已复核最新 1.1.0，将收录，并注明 Python/MCP 依赖、自动记忆和首次模型下载要求 😊

本轮已做静态安全审查，该版本上架后会显示「已审查」标签。
补充复查了 0.1.2：流式读取仍在 start() 内持续预读整段，慢客户端的缓冲问题尚未修复，暂不迁移。请改为按 pull() 需求读取并处理取消；当前固定旧版也有这个问题。修复后可继续复核。

Thanks for reporting this! The screenshot shows Open Market waiting for the optional `remote.pluginMarket` service. I reproduced the dependency problem and fixed it in the source; npm 0.2.4 does not contain the fix yet.

For now, disable `dsh-open-market` in the recovery screen’s Plugin Manager and restart. Then enable **Plugins → Experimental plugins → Custom plugin markets**, restart, and re-enable Open Market. Please share your DSH and `dsh-open-market` versions; if it still fails, include the relevant diagnostics with secrets removed.
补充复核了新检测到的 Mobile 0.6.18，包与本轮静态安全检查通过，将更新并绑定该版本的「已审查」标签。视频预览 0.1.2 仍有整段预读问题，暂不升级；其余待补条目保持现状。
